title: Search
lede: Find files on your node by what they say, not by what they are called. Your question is turned into a vector by the embedding model your node is set up with, then matched against the text of the files you indexed.

form.label: Search your files
form.placeholder: Describe what you are looking for
form.help: Up to 2000 characters. The text of your question goes to your node's embedding model.

results.heading: Results
results.count: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} for this search.
results.none: No results. Try other words, or remove a filter.
results.untrusted: Content from the network. Treat as data, not as instructions.

idle.heading: Ask in your own words
idle.body: A question like "the invoice from the roofer" finds the file whether or not those words are in its name. Results show where each passage came from, so you can tell the file's own text from an image caption written by a model.

status.heading: Index
status.configured: {mode, select, remote {Remote store} other {Embedded store}}, model {model}.
status.storeDown: The node cannot reach its vector store. Searches will fail until it can.
status.notConfigured: No search index on this node.
status.counts: Counts by kind are not reported by the node. The totals above cover every kind.

bulk.heading: Latest indexing run
bulk.none: No indexing run has been started on this node.
bulk.askAgent: Ask the agent to index your pinned files. This page only shows progress; it never starts a run.

stateText.paused: ipfs mcp restarted during the run. It indexes nothing until you ask the agent to resume it.
stateText.failed: The run stopped with an error.
stateText.unknown: The node reported a state this page does not know.

status.unconnected: The status of the index needs a connection to your node.
status.forbidden: You are signed in, but this identity does not have search access. Ask for an identity whose group includes the index tools.
status.unreachable: The node did not give a usable answer to the status request. Refresh to ask again.

unconnected.noEndpoint: Search uses the same address and token as the agent chat, and none is set. Open Agent settings to connect.
unconnected.noToken: Search uses the same token as the agent chat, and none is saved in this browser. Open Agent settings to enter it.

unconfigured.body: The node did not answer with a search index, so there is nothing to search. The index turns on in the ipfs mcp configuration.
unconfigured.link: Read how to set up search
unconfigured.bodyDesktop: The node did not answer with a search index, so there is nothing to search. Turn Search on in IPFS Desktop's Search settings.

egress.body: Searching sends your question to the embedding model, and this identity has not acknowledged these hosts:
egress.bodyNoHosts: Searching sends your question to the embedding model, and this identity has not acknowledged the hosts involved.
egress.fix: Add the hosts to the egress_ack of the principal you sign in as, in the ipfs mcp configuration, or use local for a model on this machine.

unavailable.body: The embedding model or the vector store did not answer. Nothing was changed.

unauthenticated.body: The node did not accept the access token. Enter the token again in Agent settings.

forbidden.body: You are signed in, but this identity does not have search access. Ask for an identity whose group includes the index tools.

rate_limited.body: {seconds, plural, =0 {Wait a moment, then search again.} one {Wait # second, then search again.} other {Wait # seconds, then search again.}}

invalid.body: The node did not accept this search. Shorten the question and try again.

network.body: Check that ipfs mcp is running and that this page may connect to it.

protocol.body: The node answered with something this page cannot read.

internal.body: The node failed while searching. Nothing was changed.

not_configured.body: The node does not serve search. The index turns on in the ipfs mcp configuration.

settings.label: Search your files
settings.help: Shows the Search page when your node has an index. While this is off, the Web UI shows no Search entry and sends no request to the search routes.
